g.text: DESIGN PREVIEW · 320 simulated points · Not measured Symphonia performance
One dot represents one hypothetical consultation. Faint dots show individual variation;
shading and contours show concentration; marginal curves show each axis separately.
Contours enclose 50% and 90% of the smoothed illustrative density, not confidence intervals.
All coordinates are generated solely to preview the figure design. No models were evaluated.
